# action.docker_container_cp

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: action. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

Copies a file or directory into an existing container at any time, like `docker container cp SRC CONTAINER:PATH`. The source is inline `content`, `content_base64` or a local `source` path (a file or a directory, copied recursively); it is packed into a tar archive and extracted by the daemon (`PUT /containers/{id}/archive`), so the container may be running or stopped. docker_container's `files` block covers files that must exist before the first start.

Actions need Terraform >= 1.14. They keep no state: they run when a
resource's `lifecycle { action_trigger { ... } }` fires, or on demand with
`terraform apply -invoke=action.docker_container_cp.<name>`. Arguments go inside
the action's `config` block.

## Usage

```terraform
action "docker_container_cp" "<name>" {
  config {
    # arguments below
  }
}

# Run it: lifecycle { action_trigger { events = [after_create] actions = [action.docker_container_cp.<name>] } }
# on a resource, or: terraform apply -invoke=action.docker_container_cp.<name>
```

## Arguments and attributes

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `allow_overwrite_dir_with_file` | `bool` | optional |  |  | Let a file replace an existing directory of the same name (Engine `noOverwriteDirNonDir=false`). Default `false`. |
| `container_id` | `string` | required |  |  | The container the action targets, by ID or name, e.g. `docker_container.app.id`. |
| `content` | `string` | optional |  |  | Inline UTF-8 file content. Exactly one of `content`, `content_base64` and `source`. |
| `content_base64` | `string` | optional |  |  | Inline binary file content, base64-encoded. Exactly one of `content`, `content_base64` and `source`. |
| `gid` | `number` | optional |  |  | Numeric group of the copied files. Default 0 (root). |
| `mode` | `string` | optional |  |  | Octal permission bits for the copied files, e.g. `0644` or `0755`. Default `0644` for inline content, the local file's mode for `source`. |
| `path` | `string` | required |  |  | Absolute destination path inside the container: the file to write, or the directory to create for a directory `source`. Its parent directory must exist. |
| `result_path` | `string` | optional |  |  | Local file the action writes its result object to after a successful run. The file holds one JSON object keyed by the action's output names (`result`, the identity values, the raw outputs with their `*_sha256` hashes, and the version values), with keys sorted at every level, two-space indentation and a trailing newline; it is written atomically (temporary file, then rename) and parent directories are created. Read it in a later run with `jsondecode(file(...))` or the `local_file` data source. Sensitive values are written in full, since this is your own file, but show as `(sensitive)` in the progress message. Nothing is written when the action fails. |
| `source` | `string` | optional |  |  | Local file or directory on the machine running Terraform; `~` expands to the home directory. Exactly one of `content`, `content_base64` and `source`. |
| `uid` | `number` | optional |  |  | Numeric owner of the copied files. Default 0 (root). |

## Example

```terraform
resource "docker_container" "web" {
  name  = "web"
  image = "nginx:1.27"

  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create, after_update]
      actions = [action.docker_container_cp.index]
    }
  }
}

# Copy a page into the running container (the container may also be stopped).
#   terraform apply -invoke=action.docker_container_cp.index
action "docker_container_cp" "index" {
  config {
    container_id = docker_container.web.id
    path         = "/usr/share/nginx/html/index.html"
    content      = "<h1>deployed by Terraform</h1>"
    mode         = "0644"
  }
}
```
